notes: Every rule has verified=true ONLY if the value was read in an official document by the maintainers. Rules taken from secondary sources are recorded with verified=false and are never used to produce 'does not match' results.

schemes.name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Benchmark Disabilities (Central Sector Umbrella Scheme Scholarships for Students with Disabilities)
schemes.summary: Component of the DEPwD umbrella scholarship scheme for students with benchmark disability studying in classes IX and X.
schemes.benefits: Maintenance allowance Rs 800/month (hostellers) or Rs 500/month (day scholars); disability allowance Rs 4,000/year (visual impairment/intellectual disabilities) or Rs 2,000/year (other disabilities); book allowance Rs 1,000/year (guidelines dated 25/09/2024, section 4.2).
required_documents: Valid disability certificate from competent authority
Income certificate of parent/guardian from authorised Revenue Officer
application_steps: Register/log in on the National Scholarship Portal
Complete the application when the portal window opens for the academic year
Student must first log in to the UDID portal and give consent to share UDID details (NSP notice)
schemes.verification_notes: Rules read from the DEPwD guidelines (OM 25/09/2024; copy fetched from a mirror because the depwd.gov.in PDF link was not directly extractable). DEPwD lists a later revision notice dated 04/09/2025 that was NOT read. NSP portal showed AY 2026-27 open from 1 June 2026 but the page did not list this scheme's own deadline, so accepting_applications is unknown. Slots are limited (25,000 incl. renewals); meeting criteria does not guarantee award.

rules.description: Student must have a benchmark disability (RPwD Act 2016).
Regular full-time student in class IX or X.
Parental income ceiling Rs 2.5 lakh per annum.

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Students with Benchmark Disabilities (Central Sector Umbrella Scheme Scholarships for Students with Disabilities)
schemes.summary: Component of the DEPwD umbrella scholarship scheme for students with benchmark disability in class XI up to Master's level.
schemes.benefits: Reimbursement of admission/tuition fee up to Rs 1.40 lakh/year; miscellaneous fee up to Rs 10,000/year; maintenance allowance Rs 1,200/month (hostellers) or Rs 650/month (day scholars); disability allowance Rs 4,000/year (visual/intellectual) or Rs 2,000/year (others); book allowance Rs 1,500/year (guidelines section 5b).
required_documents: Valid disability certificate from competent authority
Income certificate of parent/guardian from authorised Revenue Officer
application_steps: Register/log in on the National Scholarship Portal
Complete the application when the portal window opens for the academic year
Student must first log in to the UDID portal and give consent to share UDID details (NSP notice)
schemes.verification_notes: See pre-matric-swd. 17,000 slots incl. renewals. Not available for several excluded training courses (guidelines note 1).

rules.description: Student must have a benchmark disability.
Class XI up to Master's level in a recognised institution.
Parental income ceiling Rs 2.5 lakh per annum.

schemes.name: Top Class Education Scholarship for Students with Benchmark Disabilities (Central Sector Umbrella Scheme)
schemes.summary: For graduate and postgraduate degree/diploma courses in institutes notified by DEPwD.
schemes.benefits: Specific amounts are in section 6 of the guidelines; not transcribed in this dataset.
required_documents: Valid disability certificate from competent authority
application_steps: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal during the notified window
Confirm your institute is on the DEPwD notified list (Annexure I)
schemes.verification_notes: Income ceiling Rs 8 lakh, 300 slots incl. renewals (guidelines table, section 3). Distance-mode courses not admissible. Whether the institute is notified cannot be derived from a profile, so it is a 'more information required' check.

rules.description: Student must have a benchmark disability.
Course must be in an institute notified by DEPwD.
Parental income ceiling Rs 8 lakh per annum.

schemes.name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme (degree and diploma courses)
schemes.summary: AICTE scholarship and contingency grant for students with disabilities admitted to degree or diploma programmes at AICTE-approved institutions.
schemes.benefits: Rs 50,000 per year for incidental expenses (AICTE scheme page).
application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
schemes.verification_notes: Official AICTE page confirms the scheme, Rs 50,000/year and NSP application, but does not state eligibility. The 40% disability and Rs 8 lakh income figures come from a university notice citing AICTE (secondary), so those rules are verified=false. The old aicte-india.org URL now redirects to aicte.gov.in. Degree and diploma courses are covered by this single scheme, so they appear as one entry.

rules.description: Family income below Rs 8 lakh (from secondary source).
First year of AICTE-approved degree/diploma, or lateral entry (from secondary source).

schemes.name: Free Coaching Scholarship for Students with Disabilities (Central Sector Umbrella Scheme)
schemes.summary: Coaching for competitive recruitment examinations and entrance examinations for professional and technical courses.
schemes.benefits: Free coaching through implementing agencies; online coaching is not supported (guidelines section 14).
application_steps: Check the implementing agencies and courses notified by DEPwD
Apply as invited through the implementing agency / portal
schemes.verification_notes: Guidelines table: 1,000 slots, income ceiling Rs 8 lakh, 30% female reservation. Revision noted on DEPwD page dated 24/02/2025 was not read. Listed as a verified scheme in the same DEPwD guidelines; it replaces a duplicate AICTE degree/diploma entry from the original request.

rules.description: Income ceiling Rs 8 lakh per annum.
This is coaching for competitive recruitment or entrance examinations (guidelines section 14.2); online coaching is not supported. Check that it suits the applicant's goals.

schemes.name: Scheme of Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)
schemes.summary: Funds durable, certified assistive devices and, where needed, corrective surgery through implementing agencies.
schemes.benefits: Assistive devices and aids; includes a cochlear implant component (DEPwD ADIP page).
required_documents: Aadhaar (gazette notification dated 29/02/2024 for adults and children)
application_steps: Individuals apply for a device on the ADIP portal (adip.depwd.gov.in)
schemes.verification_notes: Scheme revised effective 26/09/2024; approved only up to 31/03/2026 (end of 15th Finance Commission cycle), so continuation beyond that date was NOT confirmed. Eligibility (disability %, income) is in the revised-scheme PDF which was not read, so no eligibility rules are recorded.

schemes.name: Deendayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme (DDRS) / Deendayal Divyangjan Rehabilitation Scheme
schemes.summary: Grant-in-aid to registered NGOs running rehabilitation projects. Individuals do not apply directly; they may benefit through services of funded NGOs.
application_steps: NGOs: register on NGO Darpan, then apply via the e-Anudaan portal (grants.depwd.gov.in)
schemes.verification_notes: Revised guidelines effective 01/10/2024. Applications accepted only when notified in a given year; open/closed status unknown. The page uses both 'Divyangjan' and 'Disabled' in the name.

rules.description: Grants are for registered organisations, not individuals.

schemes.name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) Project
schemes.summary: National database and identity card for persons with disabilities. It is a certification/identity programme, not a cash-benefit scheme; many other schemes require the UDID.
required_documents: Aadhaar (mandatory for adults and children per notifications dated 08/08/2023)
application_steps: Register on the UDID portal (swavlambancard.gov.in)
Apply for disability certificate and UDID card after login
Offline applications are also accepted and later digitised
schemes.verification_notes: Page lists 21 disabilities (subject to updates). Disability percentage is assessed by medical authority. Page last updated 11 June 2026.

schemes.name: Scheme for Implementation of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 (SIPDA)
schemes.summary: Grant-in-aid to State Governments and government-established bodies for accessibility, certification camps, skill development and related activities. Not an individual benefit scheme.
schemes.verification_notes: Page gives no application process for individuals. Page last updated 30 Sept 2026.

rules.description: Grants go to State Governments and government-established bodies.

schemes.name: National Fund for Persons with Disabilities
schemes.summary: Financial assistance under DEPwD's National Fund, governed by the 2026 guidelines.
application_steps: Apply through nationalfund.depwd.gov.in
schemes.verification_notes: The 2026 guidelines PDF (dated 14/08/2026 on the page) was not read, so eligibility and permitted uses are unknown. Page footer date conflicts with document dates.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
schemes.summary: National Social Assistance Programme pension for persons with severe or multiple disabilities from BPL households.
schemes.verification_notes: nsap.nic.in and nsap.gov.in could not be reached from the verification environment. Details below come from a parliamentary answer and explainer sites (BPL household, age 18-79, severe/multiple disability, Rs 300/month central share). An 80% disability threshold was not confirmed. States top up and differ.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.summary: National Social Assistance Programme pension for older persons from BPL households.
schemes.verification_notes: Official site unreachable. Secondary sources: age 60+, BPL household, central assistance Rs 200/month (60-79) and Rs 500/month (80+). Not confirmed on an official page.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
schemes.summary: National Social Assistance Programme pension for widows from BPL households.
schemes.verification_notes: Official site unreachable. Secondary sources: widow aged 40-79, BPL household, Rs 300/month central share (a parliamentary answer). Sources conflict on some figures.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
schemes.summary: Contributory pension scheme for small and marginal farmers.
schemes.verification_notes: The official FAQ/operational-guidelines PDFs on pmkisan.gov.in could not be opened directly (TLS certificate error), so rules are quotes seen via search and are verified=false. Eligibility: small/marginal farmers, cultivable land up to 2 hectares, age 18-40, name in land records as on 01.08.2019. Whether the scheme still enrols new members was NOT confirmed. Note: the maandhan.in portal does not list PM-KMY under that name. The pension amount (Rs 3,000/month at age 60) was seen only as a search-result quote of the official operational guidelines, so it is deliberately not shown as a benefit.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)
schemes.summary: Cashless hospitalisation cover for eligible families, with a separate extension for citizens aged 70 and above.
schemes.verification_notes: nha.gov.in/pmjay.gov.in returned no usable content (blank page / connection refused). Secondary sources report Rs 5 lakh/family/year, SECC-2011-based eligibility, and age 70+ regardless of income. SECC eligibility cannot be determined from a self-reported profile, so recommendation text must say 'check eligibility with the official beneficiary portal'.

rules.description: Age 70+ extension (secondary source); other families depend on SECC listing.

schemes.name: Scholarship to Son and Daughter of Differently Abled Persons (Tamil Nadu Welfare Board for Differently Abled Persons)
schemes.summary: Educational assistance for wards of differently abled persons enrolled in the Tamil Nadu Welfare Board.
schemes.benefits: Annual amounts by level of study, e.g. Rs 3,000 (UG), Rs 4,000 (PG), Rs 5,000 (law/engineering/medicine and similar), with higher rates for hostel students (Policy Note 2024-25, Table 13).
application_steps: Enrol the differently abled person / family members (above 10 years) in the Welfare Board at the District Differently Abled Welfare Office
Apply for assistance through the District Differently Abled Welfare Office
schemes.verification_notes: Read from the official Policy Note 2024-25 (Department for Welfare of Differently Abled Persons). Amounts for school levels (Table 13 items a-c) were not transcribed. Required documents and any income/percentage criteria are not stated in the note. scd.tn.gov.in failed TLS verification so the department site was not read.

sources.title: Policy Note 2024-25, Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
TN Commissionerate for Welfare of the Differently Abled (TLS error)

rules.description: Parent/guardian is a differently abled person enrolled in the Welfare Board.
Assistance is for sons/daughters pursuing study.

schemes.name: Unemployment Allowance for Differently Abled Persons (Tamil Nadu)
schemes.summary: Monthly allowance for differently abled persons who remain unemployed for more than a year after registering with the employment exchange, for up to 10 years or until employed.
schemes.benefits: Rs 600/month (10th completed), Rs 750/month (12th completed), Rs 1,000/month (degree completed) (Policy Note 2024-25, Table 10).
application_steps: Register with the employment exchange
Apply through the District Differently Abled Welfare Office
schemes.verification_notes: From Policy Note 2024-25. The note does not state a minimum disability percentage, age limit or income ceiling; none are encoded. Rates may have been revised since.

rules.description: Unemployed for more than a year after employment-exchange registration.

schemes.name: Financial Assistance to Differently Abled Persons with High Support Need (Tamil Nadu)
schemes.summary: Monthly assistance to the caretaker of a differently abled person certified as having high support need.
schemes.benefits: Rs 1,000/month to the care taker (Policy Note 2024-25, section 15.2).
required_documents: Certification as 'differently abled person with high support need' on recommendation of the Assessment Board
application_steps: Apply through the District Differently Abled Welfare Office; the Assessment Board must certify high support need
schemes.verification_notes: Only the amount, payee (care taker) and Assessment Board certification are stated in the note. The requested name 'Personal Assistance Allowance' was not found; the official name in the Policy Note is used.

rules.description: Certified as high support need by the Assessment Board.

schemes.name: Travel Concession for Differently Abled Persons (Tamil Nadu)
schemes.summary: Free bus travel with a bus pass for education, employment, training or treatment, plus a 75% concession on Government buses (except A/C) for all categories.
schemes.benefits: 100% free travel in Government buses with bus pass (residence to place of education/employment/training/treatment; white-board town buses with escort); visually impaired may use mofussil buses up to 100 km. 75% concession on all Government buses except A/C (Policy Note 2024-25, sections 15.6.1-15.6.2).
application_steps: Obtain the bus pass through the District Differently Abled Welfare Office / transport corporation
schemes.verification_notes: Concession terms verified from the Policy Note. The exact pass-issuing procedure and documents are not stated; do not present the steps above as exhaustive.

schemes.name: Maintenance Allowance for Differently Abled Persons (Tamil Nadu)
schemes.summary: Monthly maintenance allowance for specified categories of differently abled persons.
schemes.benefits: Rs 2,000/month, paid to the beneficiary's account through the District Differently Abled Welfare Office (Policy Note 2024-25, section 15.1).
application_steps: Apply at the District Differently Abled Welfare Office; applications are scrutinised and paid to the bank account
schemes.verification_notes: Eligible categories and minimum percentages read from Table 9: intellectual disability 40%+; severely affected 75%+; Parkinson's, spinal cord injury, multiple sclerosis 40%+; muscular dystrophy 40%+; leprosy-affected 40%+. The engine checks the three eligible categories (75%+, intellectual 40%+, or a listed condition at 40%+) and asks for the listed-condition answer when needed. Secondary sources quoted lower amounts (Rs 1,500) from older years; the Policy Note value is used. Listed as a verified replacement for the requested 'Differently Abled Pension Scheme', which could not be verified.

rules.description: Differently abled person in an eligible category.

Eligible category (Policy Note 2024-25, Table 9): severely affected 75%+; intellectual disability 40%+; or Parkinson's disease, spinal cord injury, multiple sclerosis, muscular dystrophy or leprosy-affected at 40%+.
